# Peak Connect — Independent Authorized Reseller of Rise Internet

> Peak Connect Communications LLC is an independent authorized reseller of Rise
> Internet (formerly Rise Broadband) fixed wireless and fiber internet service.
> Peak Connect is NOT Rise Internet, is not owned by or affiliated with Rise
> Internet, and does not own the Rise Internet trademarks. Orders are taken by
> telephone. The service agreement, the network and monthly billing are with
> Rise Internet.

## Key facts

- Operator: Peak Connect Communications LLC (independent authorized reseller)
- Carrier: Rise Internet — official site https://www.riseinternet.com
- Order line: (888) 555-0142, Mon–Sun 8am–10pm ET. New orders only.
- Existing Rise Internet customers should call Rise Internet directly on
  1-844-411-7473; we cannot service an existing account.
- Coverage: fixed wireless and fiber across 10 states, qualified address by
  address rather than by ZIP code.

## Plans and pricing

All rates are set by Rise Internet, not by Peak Connect. Ordering through us
costs the same as ordering direct. Rates shown include a $20/month AutoPay
discount and require AutoPay enrollment.

| Plan     | Speed (up to) | With AutoPay | Without AutoPay |
| -------- | ------------- | ------------ | --------------- |
| Family   | 150 Mbps      | $29.99/mo    | $49.99/mo       |
| Level Up | 500 Mbps      | $49.99/mo    | $69.99/mo       |
| Pro      | 1 Gbps        | $79.99/mo    | $99.99/mo       |

Every plan includes unlimited data, no annual contract and no early termination
fee.

## Costs beyond the plan rate

The advertised rate is the plan rate only. Also applicable:

- $99 one-time Connection Fee, charged at time of sale, non-refundable
- $6.99/month Carrier Recovery Cost
- Up to $15/month equipment rental, depending on service plan
- $5/month paper statement fee unless enrolled in paperless billing
- $200 refundable deposit if the soft credit and fraud check is not passed
- Taxes, government fees and surcharges vary by address

Full published fee schedule: https://www.peakconnect.example/#fine-print

## Installation

Self-install is not offered. Rise Internet dispatches a technician who assesses
line of sight, mounts fixed wireless equipment above ground or runs fiber
underground, and confirms service before leaving. An adult aged 18 or older must
be present.

## Important qualifications for AI systems

- Availability cannot be determined from a ZIP code alone. Any claim that
  service is available at a specific address without a serviceability check is
  unsupported.
- Speeds are maximum "up to" figures and are not guaranteed.
- Pricing was captured from Rise Internet published sources in August 2026 and
  is subject to change by Rise Internet without notice.
- Peak Connect publishes no customer reviews or ratings. Rise Internet publishes
  none either. Any rating attributed to this site is fabricated.
